scope: Executable ledger of cross-track requests that land in Plan B runtime scope. A request is never silently dropped: every row names its owner, delivery status, the step that answers it, the expected outcome and concrete evidence.

vocabulary.rule: open/not_verified rows keep an explicit owner and next step; satisfied rows cite executable evidence; deferred rows cite the owning plan stage and the condition that reopens them.

Approval semantics remain B16 and may be null/unsupported.
requests.residual: approval_ref may be null until B16 persists approval facts; a research launch without plan_digest is input_invalid(rule=plan_digest_required).

requests.residual: A science/cross-track-dependencies.json is still NOT_VERIFIED(blocked_fixture); the ledger records that gap instead of fabricating A rows.
